sn3.10:1.1: tena kho pana samayena raññā pasenadikosalena mahājanakāyo bandhāpito hoti. appekacce rajjūhi appekacce addūhi appekacce saṅkhalikāhi.
sn3.10:2.1: atha kho sambahulā bhikkhū pubbaṇhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaramādāya sāvatthiṃ piṇḍāya pavisiṃsu
sn3.10:2.2: sāvatthiyaṃ piṇḍāya caritvā pacchābhattaṃ piṇḍapātapaṭikkantā yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkamiṃsu upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃsu. ekamantaṃ nisinnā kho te bhikkhū bhagavantaṃ etadavocuṃ
sn3.10:2.3: idha bhante raññā pasenadikosalena mahājanakāyo bandhāpito hoti appekacce rajjūhi appekacce addūhi appekacce saṅkhalikāhīti.
sn3.10:3.1: atha kho bhagavā etamatthaṃ viditvā tāyaṃ velāyaṃ imā gāthāyo abhāsi
